status: Closed — task receipt fan-out and finalizable release contract re-verified 2026-09-02
finding: Runner-sync release work can publish a valid steward receipt but fail to fan out or reconcile task-bound runner-sync receipt expectations, leaving closeback to discover missing receipts late and forcing manual enqueue/build/release probing.
expectedBehavior: Runner-sync should expose one transaction-like lifecycle: enqueue waiting tasks, build the sealed source once, publish required artifacts and receipts through governed commit, release the steward work, then make every waiting task's close gate consume the same immutable receipt without requiring per-task manual receipt reconstruction.
evidenceOrRepro: During TASK-GIT-0028 close on 2026-07-29, a steward enqueue/build produced `.atm/history/evidence/ATM-FRAMEWORK-TEMP-codex-git-series-captain.runner-sync-receipt.json`, but pre-close still expected `TASK-GIT-0028.runner-sync-receipt.json`. `broker runner-sync reconcile-receipt` first refused with `ATM_RUNNER_SYNC_RESUME_REQUIRED`; `runner-sync release --task TASK-GIT-0028 --receipt-ref temp` failed because the receipt task id belonged to the steward. Current `writeRunnerSyncReceipt` fans out immutable receipts to every durable waiting task. On 2026-09-02, the steward-release regression exposed a stale valid-fixture shape missing `outputInventory` and finalizable coalesced attribution; after aligning it with the fail-closed receipt contract, steward release, coalesced receipt, post-close receipt, and continuation lifecycle tests all pass.
followUp: Closed. The receipt builder remains the single producer of task-local fan-out receipts; release continues to reject incomplete attribution.
